description: Keep player-on-Mara personhood refusals scoped to Mara as the target so addressed Mara actions still reach their actual objects

replacements.old:
(<VERB? MARA-EAT-ACTOR>
           <MARA-EAT-REFUSAL>)
          (<VERB? MARA-DROP-ACTOR MARA-THROW-ACTOR>
           <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (<VERB? MARA-PUT-ACTOR>
           <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,SANDWICH-BAG> <MARA-SACK-REFUSAL>)
                 (T <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)>)
          (<VERB? SQUEEZE>
           <MARA-SQUEEZE-GAG>)
          (<VERB? HELLO>
           <TELL "Mara gives you a small nod. Hello, she says. Still here." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<VERB? TAKE>
           <MARA-TAKE-REFUSAL>)
          (<VERB? PUSH MOVE DROP THROW PUT PUT-ON>
           <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (<VERB? MUNG ATTACK>
           <TELL "Mara steps clear before the action can become force. She is another adventurer, not an obtainable object." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
replacements.new:
(<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? MARA-EAT-ACTOR>>
           <MARA-EAT-REFUSAL>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? MARA-DROP-ACTOR MARA-THROW-ACTOR>>
           <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? MARA-PUT-ACTOR>>
           <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,SANDWICH-BAG> <MARA-SACK-REFUSAL>)
                 (T <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? SQUEEZE>>
           <MARA-SQUEEZE-GAG>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? HELLO>>
           <TELL "Mara gives you a small nod. Hello, she says. Still here." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? TAKE>>
           <MARA-TAKE-REFUSAL>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? PUSH MOVE DROP THROW PUT PUT-ON>>
           <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <VERB? MUNG ATTACK>>
           <TELL "Mara steps clear before the action can become force. She is another adventurer, not an obtainable object." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
